1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with a light-activated MTP affixed thereto, wherein the MTP is responsive to light activation for identification and tracking purposes.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded in the test tube.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube configured for long-term storage of biological samples.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer and is responsive to light activation.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

13. (Currently Amended) A system for storing samples comprising the assembly of claim 1, and one or more of the following: a rack specifically designed for biorepository test tubes; an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes in response to light-activated MTP signals; and an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes using light-activated MTP identification.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 adapted for low temperature operation, wherein the racks and test tubes are handled and stored at -20°C or less while maintaining light-activated MTP functionality.

15. (Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: embedding a light-activated MTP in plastic by heating the light-activated MTP to above the melting point of the plastic and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated light-activated MTP.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of reading a light-activated MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing a light-activated embedded MTP; and reading the light-activated MTP using light activation.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein the vial receptacle and the embedded light-activated MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20°C or less.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

21. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards.

22. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

23. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards.
